senses.gloss:
Maudgalya, ‘descendant of mudgala,’ is the patronymic of several persons, nāka, Śatabalākṣa, and lāṅgalāyana. A Brahmacārin of the name is mentioned in the Gopatha brāhmaṇa as disputing with glāva maitreya.
Foot notes Śatapatha brāhmaṇa, xii. 5, 2, 1; Bṛhadāraṇyaka upaniṣad, vi. 4, 4; taittirīya upaniṣad, i. 9, 1.
nirukta, xi. 6.
aitareya brāhmaṇa, v. 3, 8.
i. 1, 31; Bloomfield, Atharvaveda, 110. Cf. also Caland, Über das rituelle sūtra des baudhāyana, 35.
